summary: The process actor is the execution contract that connects delegation, pipelines, review reaction, task intake and escalation.

items.text: Orchestrator / Subagent defines who delegates; Process Actor adds claim ownership, verdict and hand-off semantics to the delegated step.
Council consumes typed findings and runs the accountable, budgeted reaction loop after a process-actor verdict.
Agent Pipelines define the versioned chain of roles and gates in which process actors claim work.
LLM-Mediated Task Creation turns human intent into the explicit objective and acceptance contract a process actor receives.
Decision-making above the code line depends on the complete process evidence emitted by every actor and hand-off.
Escalation Cascade supplies bounded routing across accountable model and human actors when evidence says the current lane cannot finish safely.
Use Agent–Computer Interface contracts for individual operations; Process Actor remains responsible for claims, leases, attempts and lifecycle verdicts across calls.
Project task, run, attempt, claim and verdict state into an append-only trace so the process path can be reconstructed and reviewed.
